scope.summary: Hardened EXPLAIN: server-generated statement-id literal, verified PLAN_TABLE (local/private-synonym shadows and identity drift unavailable; SYS.PLAN_TABLE$ fallback surfaced), EXPLAIN inside a rolled-back savepoint, hard-parse closure (ODCI statistics, domain index, VPD/OLS/RAS/redaction refuse on positive evidence; unreadable evidence admits with observation + readable audit record under R36 unless require_hard_parse_evidence; probing continues after a denial; refused policy probes count as privilege-limited, never as absence), max_query_cost enforced from the plan estimate even in read-only transactions via a bounded metadata session (unmeasurable cost admits only under !require_query_cost_estimate), doctor WARN conditional on an online probe. Commits incl. b67766f4, 1ba44b84, fb10a7b8, fb29aafa, 40e31602, dcf2a820, c2fa08df, f5f66a14, 95695872, 1730f360, 4e857252.
out_of_scope: ADB behaviour; callback classes beyond the enumerated catalog evidence (bead no-claim).
